data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 83.1m (2013: GBP 59.1m) is an improvement of GBP 6.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end. This favourable loss development is spread across multiple classes of business and years of account and is caused by both attritional losses not developing as originally anticipated and improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves. The most significant favourable development occurred on the 2012 year of account and related to the Property (Direct & Facultative) class.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable development on prior years' reserves, most significant on the 2012 year of account relating to Property (Direct & Facultative); spread across Marine (Hull & Liability), Starr Tech Onshore and Property classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a favourable prior-year development, with an improvement of GBP 6.4m (net) in claims reserves relative to the prior year. This improvement is attributed to benign catastrophe experience, lower-than-expected attritional and large loss activity, resolution of legacy issues and specific favourable development on the 2012 year of account, particularly within Property and Marine-related lines. No gross prior-year movement is explicitly stated in the technical notes, so the reported GBP 6.4m figure is net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior year reserve movement (gross claims outstanding movement attributable to prior years) was presented in the notes. The report states a GBP 6.4m improvement but explicitly as a net figure within 'net claims incurred'. Per instructions, the gross prior-year development is not available and the net figure has been used as a fallback. Starr Tech Onshore was mapped to 'Professional Lines' for LOB mapping by inference.
